words.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
words.zh: 我突然用力踩下刹车踏板，我们都被向前抛了出去。

words.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
words.zh: 考官悲伤地看着我。

words.en: 'Mr. Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
words.zh: '先生。伊姆斯，”他用悲伤的声音说道，“你刚刚杀了那个孩子！”

words.en: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
words.zh: 在一次斗牛中，一个醉汉突然溜进斗牛场中央。

words.en: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
words.zh: 人群开始叫喊，但醉汉并没有意识到危险。

words.en: The bull was busy with the matador at the time, but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
words.zh: 当时公牛正忙着对付斗牛士，却突然看到了那个喊着粗鲁话、挥舞着红帽子的醉汉。

words.en: Apparently sensitive to criticism, the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
words.zh: 公牛显然对批评很敏感，完全忘记了斗牛士，并向醉汉冲去。

words.en: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
words.zh: 人群顿时安静了下来。

words.en: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
words.zh: 然而，醉汉似乎对自己很有信心。

words.en: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
words.zh: 当公牛靠近他时，他笨拙地退到一边让它过去。

words.en: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
words.zh: 人群爆发出欢呼声，醉汉鞠躬。

words.en: By this time, however three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
words.zh: 这时，三名男子已经进入了擂台，他们很快就把醉汉拖到了安全的地方。

words.en: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
words.zh: 就连公牛似乎也为他感到难过，因为它同情地看着醉汉，直到醉汉走开，才再次将注意力转向斗牛士。

words.en: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben, the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
words.zh: 当您访问伦敦时，您首先看到的就是大本钟，这座著名的时钟可以在 B.B.C. 的节目中在全世界听到。

words.en: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.
words.zh: 如果 1834 年议会大厦没有被烧毁，这座大钟就永远不会竖立起来。

words.en: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
words.zh: 大本钟得名于本杰明霍尔爵士，他在新议会大厦建造时负责制作大钟。

words.en: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
words.zh: 它不仅尺寸巨大，而且极其精确。

words.en: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
words.zh: 格林威治天文台的官员每天检查时钟两次。

words.en: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
words.zh: 在 B.B.C.当时钟真正敲响时，您可以听到时钟的声音，因为麦克风连接到钟塔。

words.en: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
words.zh: 大本钟很少出错。

words.en: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.
words.zh: 然而，有一次它未能给出正确的时间。

words.en: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
words.zh: 一位一直在修塔的油漆工，在其中一只手上挂了一盆油漆，放慢了速度！

words.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
words.zh: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士是第一个驾驶速度超过每小时 300 英里的人。

words.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
words.zh: 1935 年 9 月，他在犹他州博纳维尔盐滩创造了新的世界纪录。

words.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
words.zh: 他驾驶的蓝鸟汽车是专门为他打造的。

words.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
words.zh: 它长超过 30 英尺，配有 2,500 马力的发动机。

words.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
words.zh: 尽管坎贝尔的速度达到了每小时 304 英里以上，但他在控制赛车方面遇到了很大困难，因为在第一次行驶时轮胎就爆了。

words.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
words.zh: 尝试后，坎贝尔失望地发现他的平均速度为每小时 299 英里。

words.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
words.zh: 然而，几天后，他被告知犯了一个错误。

words.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
words.zh: 他的平均速度为每小时 301 英里。

words.en: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
words.zh: 从那时起，赛车手的时速已超过 600 英里。

words.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
words.zh: 多年后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德追随父亲的脚步，也创造了一项世界纪录。

words.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
words.zh: 和他的父亲一样，他驾驶着一辆名为“蓝鸟”的汽车。

words.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
words.zh: 逃学的孩子缺乏想象力。

words.en: A quiet days' fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
words.zh: 他们通常能安静地钓鱼几天，或者在电影院里一遍又一遍地看同一部电影八个小时。

words.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant travelled 1,600 miles.
words.zh: 他们都被一个逃学一千六百英里的男孩羞辱了。

words.en: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
words.zh: 他搭便车到多佛，傍晚时分上船寻找睡觉的地方。

words.en: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
words.zh: 第二天早上，当他醒来时，他发现船此时已驶往加莱。

words.en: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
words.zh: 当男孩悄悄离开时，没有人注意到他。

words.en: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
words.zh: 从那里，他搭卡车前往巴黎。

words.en: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
words.zh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，然后把他留在了城外。

words.en: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
words.zh: 男孩拦下的下一辆车并没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是开往法国与西班牙边境的佩皮尼昂。

words.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
words.zh: 在那里，他被一名警察接走，并被地方当局送回英国。

words.en: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
words.zh: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃学的孩子创造了一项记录。

words.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
words.zh: 一辆古老的公共汽车停在干涸的河床边，一群著名的男女演员下了车。

words.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
words.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，采取了特殊的预防措施，以免被人认出。

words.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
words.zh: 但他们很快发现，伪装有时可能过于完美。

words.en: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
words.zh: “这是野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格莱姆说。

words.en: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
words.zh: “这再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯表示同意。

words.en: 'No newspaper men, no film fans!
words.zh: “没有报纸人，没有电影迷！

words.en: Why don't we come more often?'
words.zh: 我们为什么不经常来呢？

words.en: Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
words.zh: 与此同时，另外两名演员罗克沃尔·斯林格（Rockwall Slinger）和梅林·格里夫斯（Merlin Greeves）提着两个大食物篮到树下的阴凉处。

words.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
words.zh: 当他们都舒服了之后，一个陌生人出现了。

words.en: He looked very angry.
words.zh: 他看起来很生气。

words.en: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
words.zh: “现在你们都离开这里！”他喊道。

words.en: 'I'm sheriff here.
words.zh: “我是这里的警长。

words.en: Do you see that notice?
words.zh: 你看到那个通知了吗？

words.en: It says "No Camping" — in case you can't read!'
words.zh: 上面写着“禁止露营”——以防你看不懂！

words.en: 'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall, 'don't be too hard on us.
words.zh: “听着，警长，”罗克沃尔说，“别对我们太严厉。

words.en: I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
words.zh: 我是罗克沃尔投石手，这是梅林·格里夫斯。

words.en: 'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
words.zh: “哦，是吗？”治安官冷笑着说道。

words.en: 'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam.
words.zh: “嗯，我是布林克斯利·梅尔斯，我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格莱姆。

words.en: Now you get out of here fast!'
words.zh: 现在你快点离开这里吧！”

words.en: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago, it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
words.zh: 前段时间，一架轻型客机偏离航线，坠落在山上，飞行员丧生。

words.en: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
words.zh: 唯一的乘客是一名年轻女子和她的两个小女儿，没有受伤。

words.en: It was the middle of winter.
words.zh: 那是隆冬。

words.en: Snow lay thick on the ground.
words.zh: 地上积了厚厚的雪。

words.en: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
words.zh: 这位女士知道最近的村庄在数英里之外。

words.en: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it, covering them with all the clothes she could find.
words.zh: 天黑后，她把一个手提箱变成了一张床，把孩子们放进了里面，并用她能找到的所有衣服盖住了他们。

words.en: During the night, it got terribly cold.
words.zh: 到了晚上，天气变得非常冷。

words.en: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
words.zh: 这位女士尽可能地靠近孩子们，甚至试图自己进入箱子，但箱子太小了。

words.en: Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
words.zh: 第二天一早，她听到飞机从头顶飞过，想知道如何发送信号。

words.en: Then she had an idea.
words.zh: 然后她有了一个主意。

words.en: She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
words.zh: 她在雪地里踩出了“SOS”三个字母。

words.en: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
words.zh: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看到了信号，并通过无线电向最近的城镇发送了一条消息。

words.en: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
words.zh: 不久，一架直升机抵达现场营救空难的幸存者。

words.en: 'To end our special news bulletin,' said the voice of the television announcer, 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
words.zh: “为了结束我们的特别新闻报道，”电视播音员的声音说道，“我们要去卡拉布里亚的通心粉田。

words.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
words.zh: 该地区种植通心粉已有六百多年的历史。

words.en: Two of the leading growers Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante, tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
words.zh: 两位主要种植者朱塞佩·摩尔多瓦 (Giuseppe Moldova) 和里卡多·布拉班特 (Riccardo Brabante) 告诉我，他们一直期待今年会有丰收，而且收获工作比往常更早开始。

words.en: Here you can see two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
words.zh: 在这里，您可以看到两名工人刚刚完成了三车金黄色通心粉茎的切割。

words.en: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.
words.zh: 在九月下雨之前，全村人都在夜以继日地收割今年的庄稼。

words.en: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.
words.zh: 在右边，您可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。

words.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
words.zh: 三十年来，她一直在帮助她的丈夫。

words.en: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
words.zh: 布拉班特夫人正在与当地加工农作物的工厂的经理交谈。

words.en: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
words.zh: 最后一个场景向您展示了收获结束时会发生什么：著名的卡拉布里亚通心粉吃比赛！

words.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
words.zh: 现任冠军弗拉泰利先生自 1991 年以来每年都获得冠军。

words.en: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
words.zh: 今天 4 月 1 日星期四的特别公告到此结束。

words.en: We're now going back to the studio.'
words.zh: 我们现在要回工作室了。”

words.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
words.zh: 一位死于公元前 800 年的埃及妇女的木乃伊刚刚做了手术。

words.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
words.zh: 这具木乃伊是谢彭穆特的木乃伊，他曾经是底比斯神庙的歌手。

words.en: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy, doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
words.zh: 由于木乃伊的X光片上有奇怪的痕迹，医生一直在试图查明这名妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。

words.en: The only way to do this was to operate.
words.zh: 做到这一点的唯一方法就是操作。

words.en: The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
words.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时，由于皮肤上覆盖着坚硬的树脂，手术非常困难。

words.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
words.zh: 医生取出木乃伊的一部分并将其送往实验室。

words.en: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
words.zh: 他们还发现了 X 光片没有显示的东西：杜阿穆特夫神的小蜡像。

words.en: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
words.zh: 这个长着牛头的神通常被放置在木乃伊体内。

words.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
words.zh: 医生尚未确定该女子是如何死亡的。

words.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open, but fortunately this has not happened.
words.zh: 他们担心切开木乃伊后会碎成碎片，但幸运的是这并没有发生。

words.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
words.zh: 木乃伊在手术中顺利存活。

words.en: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
words.zh: 读完一篇题为“吸烟与健康”的文章后，我点了一支烟来平静自己的神经。

words.en: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
words.zh: 我专注而愉快地抽烟，因为我确信这将是我的最后一支烟。

words.en: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.
words.zh: 整整一个星期我根本没有抽烟，在这段时间里我的妻子遭受了极大的痛苦。

words.en: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
words.zh: 我具有戒烟者的所有常见症状：脾气暴躁和食欲旺盛。

words.en: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
words.zh: 我的朋友们不断地给我香烟和雪茄。

words.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
words.zh: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰他们的乐趣。

words.en: After seven days of this I went to a party.
words.zh: 七天后，我去参加一个聚会。

words.en: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
words.zh: 我周围的每个人都在吸烟，我感到非常不舒服。

words.en: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
words.zh: 当我的老朋友布莱恩劝我接受一支香烟时，我实在无法忍受。

words.en: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
words.zh: 我愧疚地接过一根，点燃它，心满意足地抽着烟。

words.en: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
words.zh: 我的妻子很高兴事情再次恢复正常。

words.en: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
words.zh: 不管怎样，正如布莱恩指出的，戒烟是世界上最容易的事情。

words.en: He himself has done it lots of times!
words.zh: 他自己已经做过很多次了！

words.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
words.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我经常乘飞机旅行。

words.en: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
words.zh: 我的父母曾经住在南美洲，我经常在假期从欧洲飞往那里。

words.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
words.zh: 空姐会照顾我，我从未有过不愉快的经历。

words.en: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
words.zh: 我习惯了乘飞机旅行，只有一次我感到害怕。

words.en: After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
words.zh: 起飞后，我们在城市上空低空飞行，慢慢升高高度，突然掉头飞回机场。

words.en: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
words.zh: 当我们等待降落时，空姐告诉我们要保持冷静，飞机一落地就安静地下机。

words.en: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
words.zh: 船上的每个人都很担心，我们很好奇到底发生了什么事。

words.en: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
words.zh: 后来我们才知道，船上有一个非常重要的人。

words.en: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
words.zh: 警方被告知飞机上安放了一枚炸弹。

words.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
words.zh: 我们降落后，飞机被彻底搜查。

words.en: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
words.zh: 幸运的是，什么也没找到，五个小时后我们又能够起飞了。

words.en: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the 19th century was the Crystal Palace which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
words.zh: 也许 19 世纪最非凡的建筑是为 1851 年万国博览会而在海德公园建造的水晶宫。

words.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
words.zh: 水晶宫与世界上所有其他建筑不同，它是由铁和玻璃制成的。

words.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
words.zh: 它是有史以来最大的建筑之一，许多国家的人们前来参观。

words.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
words.zh: 展会上有来自世界各地的大量货物。

words.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
words.zh: 现场还展出了大量机械设备。

words.en: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
words.zh: 展出的最精彩的机械是纳斯米斯的蒸汽锤。

words.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
words.zh: 尽管当时的旅行并不像今天那么容易，但蒸汽船却载着成千上万的游客从欧洲穿越英吉利海峡。

words.en: On arriving in England, they were, taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
words.zh: 抵达英国后，他们乘火车前往水晶宫。

words.en: There were six million visitors in all, and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
words.zh: 总共有六百万参观者，展览的利润被用来建造博物馆和大学。

words.en: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
words.zh: 后来，水晶宫迁至伦敦南部。

words.en: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
words.zh: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到 1936 年被烧毁。

words.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
words.zh: 当他杀死了守卫后，战俘迅速将他拖进了灌木丛中。

words.en: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
words.zh: 他在黑暗中飞快地工作，很快就换上了死者的衣服。

words.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
words.zh: 现在，这名囚犯穿着蓝色制服，肩上扛着步枪，在集中营前大胆地走来走去。

words.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
words.zh: 他能听到营地里的喊叫声。

words.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
words.zh: 灯火通明，人们四处奔走：他们刚刚发现一名囚犯越狱了。

words.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
words.zh: 这时，一辆黑色大车停在营地门口，车上载着四名警察。

words.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
words.zh: 军官们下了车，囚犯在他们经过时立正敬礼。

words.en: When they had gone the driver of the car came towards him.
words.zh: 他们走后，汽车司机向他走来。

words.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
words.zh: 男人显然是想说话。

words.en: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
words.zh: 他年纪相当大了，头发花白，蓝眼睛清澈。

words.en: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
words.zh: 犯人为他感到难过，但也无能为力。

words.en: As the man came near the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
words.zh: 当这名男子走近时，囚犯猛烈一击，将他打倒在地。

words.en: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
words.zh: 然后，他跳上车，以最快的速度开走。

words.en: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
words.zh: 渔民和水手有时声称在海中看到了怪物。

words.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
words.zh: 尽管人们经常嘲笑海员讲述的故事，但现在人们知道，这些有时会被看到的“怪物”中的许多只是奇怪的鱼。

words.en: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
words.zh: 偶尔，不寻常的生物会被冲到岸边，但很少在海上被捕获。

words.en: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
words.zh: 然而前段时间，在马达加斯加附近捕获了一种奇特的鱼。

words.en: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
words.zh: 一条小渔船被这条强大的鱼拉着钓线拖到了数英里之外。

words.en: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
words.zh: 意识到这不是一条普通的鱼，渔夫尽一切努力不让它受到任何伤害。

words.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
words.zh: 当它最终被打捞上岸时，人们发现它有超过十三英尺长。

words.en: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
words.zh: 它有一个像马一样的头，蓝色的大眼睛，闪亮的银色皮肤，还有一条鲜红色的尾巴。

words.en: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
words.zh: 这条鱼被称为皇带鱼，现已被送往博物馆，由科学家对其进行检查。

words.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
words.zh: 人类很少见到活着的此类生物，因为它们生活在六百英尺的深处。

words.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
words.zh: 前总理温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中落败。

words.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
words.zh: 他现在退出政治生活并出国了。

words.en: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
words.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生领导的激进进步党的狂热反对者。

words.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
words.zh: 选举结束后，帕特里克前往前总理官邸。

words.en: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
words.zh: 当他询问莱恩先生是否住在那儿时，值班警察告诉他，自从他落选后，这位前总理就出国了。

words.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
words.zh: 第二天帕特里克又去了那所房子。

words.en: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
words.zh: 当帕特里克问同样的问题时，同一个警察正慢慢地走过入口。

words.en: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
words.zh: 虽然有点可疑，但这次警察还是给了他同样的答案。

words.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
words.zh: 第二天，帕特里克再次来到他家，问了同样的问题。

words.en: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
words.zh: 这一次，警察发脾气了。

words.en: 'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted, 'Mr. Lane was defeated in the elections.
words.zh: “我昨天和前天都告诉过你了，”他喊道，“先生。”莱恩在选举中落败。

words.en: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
words.zh: 他已经退出政治生活，去国外生活了！”

words.en: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
words.zh: “我知道，”帕特里克回答，“但我喜欢听你这么说！”

words.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
words.zh: 巴士司机决定下周举行罢工。

words.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
words.zh: 罢工定于周二开始。

words.en: No one knows how long it will last.
words.zh: 没有人知道它会持续多久。

words.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
words.zh: 公交车司机表示，罢工将继续下去，直到就工资和工作条件达成普遍协议为止。

words.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
words.zh: 大多数人认为罢工将持续至少一周。

words.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
words.zh: 许多私家车车主将在上班途中为人们提供“免费乘车”服务。

words.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
words.zh: 这将在一定程度上缓解列车的压力。

words.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
words.zh: 与此同时，一些大学生自愿在罢工持续期间驾驶公共汽车。

words.en: All the students are expert drivers, but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
words.zh: 所有学生都是专业司机，但在驾驶任何公共汽车之前，他们必须通过特殊测试。

words.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
words.zh: 两天后，学生们就要参加考试了。

words.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
words.zh: 即便如此，人们还是会发现上班很困难。

words.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
words.zh: 但到目前为止，公众已经在给媒体的信中表达了对学生的感谢。

words.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
words.zh: 只有一两个人反对，认为学生开得太快了！

courses.title: Lesson 85 · Never Too Old To Learn

words.en: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
words.zh: 我刚刚收到母校的一封信，通知我我的前校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生将于下周退休。

words.en: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
words.zh: 学校的新老学生都会送他一份礼物以示纪念。

words.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
words.zh: 所有为这份礼物做出贡献的人都将在一本大相册上签名，然后将其寄到校长家中。

words.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
words.zh: 我们都会记住佩奇先生的耐心和理解，以及当我们不情愿去学校时他给予我们的善意鼓励。

words.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
words.zh: 下周四，许多以前的学生将参加为他举行的告别晚宴。

words.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
words.zh: 一个奇怪的巧合是，在佩奇先生退休的前一天，他已经教书四十年了。

words.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
words.zh: 退休后，他将全身心投入园艺工作。

words.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
words.zh: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。

words.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
words.zh: 但这并不重要，因为正如他经常说的，学习永远不嫌老。

words.en: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
words.zh: 当该男子试图转动快艇时，他手中的方向盘脱落了。

words.en: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
words.zh: 他绝望地向他的同伴挥手，他的同伴在过去的十五分钟里一直在滑水。

words.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
words.zh: 两人还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛烈地扔进了海里。

words.en: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
words.zh: 快艇撞上了浮标，但它继续在水面上快速移动。

words.en: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore, when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
words.zh: 两人刚开始向岸边游去，就惊愕地发现快艇正在转圈。

words.en: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
words.zh: 现在它以极快的速度直冲着他们而来。

words.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
words.zh: 不到一分钟，它就在距离他们只有几英尺的地方呼啸而过。

words.en: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
words.zh: 船过去后，他们以最快的速度继续游，因为他们知道船很快就会回来。

words.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
words.zh: 他们刚有足够的时间游出危险，船又绕了一圈。

words.en: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
words.zh: 然而，这一次，它的速度明显减慢了。

words.en: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
words.zh: 汽油几乎都用完了。

words.en: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
words.zh: 不久，噪音完全消失，小船开始轻轻地在水面上漂流。

words.en: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
words.zh: “谋杀案发生时，我正乘坐八点钟的火车前往伦敦，”该男子说。

words.en: 'Do you always catch such an early train?' asked the inspector.
words.zh: “你总是赶这么早的火车吗？”检查员问道。

words.en: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.
words.zh: “我当然知道，”那人回答道。

words.en: 'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
words.zh: “我必须在十点钟上班。

words.en: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
words.zh: 我的雇主将确认我准时到达。

words.en: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?' asked the inspector.
words.zh: “晚一点的火车能让你准时上班吗？”检查员问道。

words.en: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'
words.zh: “我想会的，但我从来没有赶上晚一点的火车。”

words.en: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'
words.zh: “你什么时候到车站的？”

words.en: 'At ten to eight.
words.zh: '十点差八点。

words.en: I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
words.zh: 我买了一份报纸然后等火车。”

words.en: 'And you didn't notice anything unusual?'
words.zh: “你没发现有什么异常吗？”

words.en: 'Of course not.'
words.zh: “当然不是。”

words.en: 'I suggest,' said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
words.zh: “我建议，”检查员说，“你没有说实话。”

words.en: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train, but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
words.zh: 我建议你不要赶8点钟的火车，但你可以赶8.25的火车，这样你仍然可以准时上班。

words.en: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
words.zh: 你看，案发当天早上，8点钟的火车根本没有运行。

words.en: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
words.zh: 它在 Ferngreen 车站发生故障并被停运。

words.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
words.zh: 六名男子被困在矿井中十七个小时。

words.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
words.zh: 如果不尽快将他们带到地面，他们可能会失去生命。

words.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
words.zh: 然而，救援行动却困难重重。

words.en: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
words.zh: 如果使用炸药，振动会导致矿井顶板倒塌。

words.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
words.zh: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个洞。

words.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
words.zh: 他们打算将这些人带入一个特殊的太空舱中。

words.en: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil, they would have completed the job in a few hours.
words.zh: 如果土壤下面没有坚硬的岩石层，他们几个小时内就能完成这项工作。

words.en: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
words.zh: 事实上，他们已经钻探了16个小时，还有很长的路要走。

words.en: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago, has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
words.zh: 与此同时，两个小时前被放入矿井的麦克风使这些人能够与他们最亲近的亲属保持联系。

words.en: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
words.zh: 尽管他们的食物和饮料已经耗尽，但人们都很高兴，并相信他们很快就会出去。

words.en: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
words.zh: 他们被告知救援行动进展顺利。

words.en: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
words.zh: 如果他们知道钻穿坚硬的岩石有多么困难，他们就会灰心丧气。

courses.title: Lesson 89 · A Slip of the Tongue

words.en: People will do anything to see a free show — even if it is a bad one.
words.zh: 人们会不惜一切代价观看免费演出——即使是一场糟糕的演出。

words.en: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
words.zh: 当 P. and U. Bird Seed Company 将在我们当地的电影院上演喜剧节目的消息传开后，我们都争先恐后地去看。

words.en: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
words.zh: 我们不得不排队几个小时才能入场，在演出开始前肯定有数百人在场。

words.en: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
words.zh: 不幸的是，这个节目是我们见过的最乏味的节目之一。

words.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed, as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
words.zh: 没能入场的人也不必感到失望，因为很多应该出场的艺人都没有来。

words.en: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
words.zh: 那天晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的事情来自节目开始时的广告商。

words.en: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
words.zh: 他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前尴尬地站了几分钟。

words.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
words.zh: 他一开口，所有人都哈哈大笑起来。

words.en: We all know what the poor man should have said, but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company.
words.zh: 我们都知道这个穷人应该说什么，但他实际上说的是：“这里是 Poo 和 Ee 种子鸟公司。”

words.en: Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
words.zh: 女士们晚上好，先生们！

words.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain, but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive.
words.zh: 炸鱼薯条一直是英国人喜爱的菜肴，但随着海洋过度捕捞，鱼变得越来越贵。

words.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs.
words.zh: 因此，当得知巨型鱼类让北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员感到恐惧时，我们感到很惊讶。

words.en: Oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water, have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work.
words.zh: 石油钻井平台必须经常维修，潜水员经常在水下一百英尺的黑暗中工作，在工作时被巨鱼撞上，吓得魂不附体。

words.en: Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
words.zh: 现在他们已经制作了特殊的笼子来保护他们免受这些怪物的伤害。

words.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
words.zh: 这些鱼不是鲨鱼或虎鲸，而是人们喜爱的鱼类，例如鳕鱼和鳐鱼，它们会长到不自然的尺寸，有时长达十二英尺。

words.en: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs; the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
words.zh: 三个因素导致这些鱼长得这么大：海底热油管周围的温水；钻井平台上的船员扔到船上的大量食物；石油钻井平台周围完全没有渔船。

words.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water.
words.zh: 结果，鱼儿就在可爱的温暖水中吃啊吃啊，生长啊生长。

words.en: Who eats who?
words.zh: 谁吃谁？

courses.title: Lesson 91 · Three Men in a Basket

words.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
words.zh: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球似乎正飞往附近的皇家空军基地。

words.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
words.zh: 他立即通知了电视台，但没有人能够解释这个谜团。

words.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news, because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
words.zh: 控制塔的官员听到这个消息后非常愤怒，因为气球对飞机来说可能是一个很大的危险。

words.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
words.zh: 他说，可能有人在监视空间站，飞行员被命令跟踪这个奇怪的物体。

words.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
words.zh: 飞行员设法绕气球飞行了一段时间。

words.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
words.zh: 他可以看到下面的一个篮子里有三个人，其中一个拿着一副双筒望远镜。

words.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
words.zh: 当气球飞到空间站上空时，飞行员看到其中一名男子正在拍照。

words.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
words.zh: 不久之后，气球开始下降并降落在机场附近。

words.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone, for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
words.zh: 警察被叫来了，但他们无法逮捕任何人，因为篮子里装着两名国会议员和车站指挥官！

words.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
words.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，车站的一半人不知道另一半人在做什么！

words.en: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
words.zh: 当我回到家的时候，应该已经是凌晨两点了。

words.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell, but she was fast asleep, so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall, and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
words.zh: 我试图按门铃叫醒我的妻子，但她睡得很熟，所以我从花园的棚子里拿了一个梯子，把它靠在墙上，开始爬向卧室的窗户。

words.en: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.
words.zh: 我快要到了，下面传来一个讽刺的声音。

words.en: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
words.zh: “我认为晚上这个时候窗户不需要清洁。”

words.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
words.zh: 当我低头一看，看到一个警察时，我差点从梯子上摔下来。

words.en: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
words.zh: 我立即后悔自己的回答，但我说：“我喜欢晚上擦窗户。”

words.en: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
words.zh: “我也是，”警察用同样的语气回答。

words.en: Excuse my interrupting you.
words.zh: 抱歉打扰你了。

words.en: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
words.zh: 我讨厌在别人忙于工作的时候打断他，但是你介意跟我一起去车站吗？

words.en: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
words.zh: “好吧，我宁愿留在这里，”我说。

words.en: 'You see, I've forgotten my key.'
words.zh: “你看，我忘记带钥匙了。”

words.en: 'Your what?' he called.
words.zh: “你的什么？”他打电话来。

words.en: 'My key,' I shouted.
words.zh: “我的钥匙，”我喊道。

words.en: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
words.zh: 幸运的是，喊叫声惊醒了我的妻子，她打开了窗户，这时警察正向我爬来。

words.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty, was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
words.zh: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一，自由女神像，由法国人民于十九世纪赠送给美国。

words.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
words.zh: 这座伟大的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，历时十年才完成。

words.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
words.zh: 实际的人物是由铜制成的，由埃菲尔专门建造的金属框架支撑。

words.en: Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
words.zh: 在它被运到美国之前，必须为其找到一个地点并建造一个基座。

words.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
words.zh: 选定的地点是纽约港入口处的一个岛屿。

words.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
words.zh: 1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像在巴黎竖立起来。
words.ipa: /bˈaɪ/ /wˈɒn θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪthˈʌndɹɪdən ˈeɪtɪ fˈɔː/ /ə/ /stˈætʃuː/ /wˈɪtʃ/ /wɒz/ /wˈɒnhˈʌndɹɪdən fˈɪftɪ wˈɒn/ /fˈiːt/ /tˈɔːl/ /hˌæd/ /bˌiːn/ /ɪɹˈɛktɪd/ /ˈɪn/ /pˈæɹɪs/

words.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
words.zh: 第二年，它被拆散并送往美国。

words.en: By the end of October 1886, the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
words.zh: 1886年10月底，雕像再次组装完毕，并由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

words.en: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
words.zh: 从那时起，这座伟大的纪念碑就成为了数百万通过纽约港在美国安家的人们的自由象征。

words.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
words.zh: 实验证明，孩子很小的时候就可以接受游泳训练。

words.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
words.zh: 在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，孩子们在学会走路之前就已经成为在水下屏住呼吸的专家。

words.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
words.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不不愿意下水。

words.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
words.zh: 没过多久，他们就习惯了游泳，可以从泳池的地板上拿起重物。

words.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
words.zh: 水下三轮车比赛是非常受这些年轻游泳运动员欢迎的游戏。

words.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
words.zh: 三轮车排列在水下七英尺的泳池地板上。

words.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
words.zh: 孩子们互相竞争，以到达泳池的另一端。

words.en: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
words.zh: 许多人骑三轮车，但大多数人更喜欢推或拖三轮车。

words.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
words.zh: 有些孩子甚至可以跑完整个泳池而一次都没有上来喘气。

words.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
words.zh: 他们是否会成为未来的奥运会冠军，只有时间才能证明。

words.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
words.zh: 与此同时，他们应该鼓励我们当中那些无法游出五码的人，然后他们就会喘不过气来。

words.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
words.zh: 当埃斯卡罗皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子大吃一惊。

words.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
words.zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也破烂不堪。

words.en: 'What has happened?' she asked.
words.zh: “发生什么事了？”她问道。

words.en: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
words.zh: “你的衣服怎么弄得这么乱？”

words.en: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
words.zh: “亲爱的，灭火器。”大使冷冷地回答。

words.en: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
words.zh: “今天早上，大学生放火焚烧了大使馆。”

words.en: 'Good heavens!' exclaimed his wife.
words.zh: “天哪！”他的妻子惊呼道。

words.en: 'And where were you at the time?'
words.zh: “当时你在哪里？”

words.en: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
words.zh: “我像往常一样在办公室，”大使回答道。

words.en: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
words.zh: “火灾是在地下室发生的。

words.en: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
words.zh: 当然，我立刻就倒下了，那个傻瓜霍斯特用灭火器瞄准了我。

words.en: He thought I was on fire.
words.zh: 他以为我着火了。

words.en: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
words.zh: 我一定要把那个家伙派出去。

words.en: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions, when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
words.zh: 大使夫人继续问问题，突然发现丈夫的帽子上有一个大洞。

words.en: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.
words.zh: “那你怎么解释呢？”她问道。

words.en: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
words.zh: “哦，那个，”大使说。

words.en: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
words.zh: “有人透过我办公室的窗户开了一枪。

words.en: Accurate, don't you think?
words.zh: 准确，你不觉得吗？

words.en: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
words.zh: 幸好当时我没戴。

words.en: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
words.zh: 如果是的话，我就无法回家吃午饭了。”

words.en: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
words.zh: 日本每年举办一次亡灵节。

words.en: This festival is a cheerful occasion, for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
words.zh: 这个节日是一个欢乐的时刻，因为据说在这一天，死者会回到自己的家，受到生者的欢迎。

words.en: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them.
words.zh: 由于长途旅行后他们预计会感到饥饿，因此为他们准备了食物。

words.en: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.
words.zh: 每间屋子外面都挂着特制的灯笼，帮助死者找到方向。

words.en: All night long, people dance and sing.
words.zh: 整个晚上，人们载歌载舞。

words.en: In the early morning the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
words.zh: 清晨，为死者准备的食物会被扔进河里或海里，因为活着的人吃了这些食物会被认为是不吉利的。

words.en: In towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water when the festival is over.
words.zh: 在靠近海边的城镇，前一天晚上挂在街上的小灯笼在节日结束后被放入水中。

words.en: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
words.zh: 数以千计的灯笼缓缓漂向大海，指引着死者返回另一个世界的旅程。

words.en: This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
words.zh: 这是一个令人感动的景象，人们站在岸边，看着灯笼渐渐远去，直到再也看不见。
